## tests/test_api.py

### The list of a new crm is an empty json list

- api_names: if called with nothing, then give []

### The api answers json

- api_content_type: if '/api/contacts', then give 'application/json'

-   giving 'application/json'
- then that gave 'application/json'

### The list has every contact in the order they were added

- and api_names() is called

- then that gave ['Ann Lee', 'Bob Stone', 'Carla Annan', 'Dan Roe']

### An email that is already taken is rejected

- given a CRM
- when add_contact(name='Ann Lee', email='ann@example.com') is called
- and errors_when_creating(name='Someone Else', email='ann@example.com') is called
-   giving {'email': 'This email is already in use.'}
- then that gave {'email': 'This email is already in use.'}
- when after_creating(name='Someone Else', email='ann@example.com') is called
-   giving 'status 400'
- then that gave 'status 400'

### An email counts as taken whatever its case or surrounding spaces

- given a CRM
- when add_contact(name='Ann Lee', email='ann@example.com') is called
- and errors_when_creating(name='Someone Else', email='ANN@EXAMPLE.COM') is called
-   giving {'email': 'This email is already in use.'}
- then that gave {'email': 'This email is already in use.'}
- when errors_when_creating(name='Someone Else', email='Ann@Example.com') is called
-   giving {'email': 'This email is already in use.'}
- then that gave {'email': 'This email is already in use.'}
- when errors_when_creating(name='Someone Else', email='  ann@example.com  ') is called
-   giving {'email': 'This email is already in use.'}
- then that gave {'email': 'This email is already in use.'}

### An email saved with capitals still blocks the lowercase version

- given a CRM
- when add_contact(name='Ann Lee', email='Ann@Example.com') is called
- and errors_when_creating(name='Someone Else', email='ann@example.com') is called
-   giving {'email': 'This email is already in use.'}
- then that gave {'email': 'This email is already in use.'}
- when errors_when_creating(name='Someone Else', email='ANN@EXAMPLE.COM') is called
-   giving {'email': 'This email is already in use.'}
- then that gave {'email': 'This email is already in use.'}

### A different email is not a duplicate even with the same name

- given a CRM
- when add_contact(name='Ann Lee', email='ann@example.com') is called
- and after_creating(name='Ann Lee', email='ann.lee@example.com') is called
-   giving 'redirect to /contacts/2'
- then that gave 'redirect to /contacts/2'

### The status must be lead customer or lost

- errors_when_creating: if name='Ann Lee', email='ann@example.com', status='vip', then give {'status': 'Status must be lead, customer or lost.'}
- errors_when_creating: if name='Ann Lee', email='ann@example.com', status='archived', then give {'status': 'Status must be lead, customer or lost.'}
- errors_when_creating: if name='Ann Lee', email='ann@example.com', status='lead customer', then give {'status': 'Status must be lead, customer or lost.'}

### A name of more than 100 characters is rejected with a message

- errors_when_creating: if name='<101 × a>', email='ann@example.com', then give {'name': 'Name must be at most 100 characters.'}
- errors_when_creating: if name='<500 × a>', email='ann@example.com', then give {'name': 'Name must be at most 100 characters.'}

### A name of exactly 100 characters is fine and spaces do not count

- after_creating: if name='<100 × a>', email='exact@example.com', then give 'redirect to /contacts/1'
- after_creating: if name='  <100 × b>  ', email='padded@example.com', then give 'redirect to /contacts/2'

### Every wrong field is reported at once

- errors_when_creating: if name='', email='nope', then give {'name': 'Name is required.', 'email': 'Enter a valid email address.'}
- errors_when_creating: if name='', email='ann@example.com', status='vip', then give {'name': 'Name is required.', 'status': 'Status must be lead, customer or lost.'}

### A refused submission answers status 400

- after_creating: if name='', email='ann@example.com', then give 'status 400'
- after_creating: if name='Ann Lee', email='nope', then give 'status 400'
- after_creating: if name='Ann Lee', email='ann@example.com', status='vip', then give 'status 400'

### The form shows again with what was typed

- kept_value_when_creating: if 'name', name='Ann Lee', email='nope', then give 'Ann Lee'
- kept_value_when_creating: if 'email', name='Ann Lee', email='nope', then give 'nope'
- kept_value_when_creating: if 'company', name='', email='ann@example.com', company='Acme Corp', then give 'Acme Corp'
- kept_value_when_creating: if 'phone', name='', email='ann@example.com', phone='555-0100', then give '555-0100'

### Nothing is stored when the submission is refused

- given a CRM
- when after_creating(name='', email='nope', status='vip') is called
-   giving 'status 400'
- then that gave 'status 400'
- when names_listed() is called
-   giving []
- then that gave []
- when pipeline_counts() is called
-   giving {'lead': 0, 'customer': 0, 'lost': 0}
- then that gave {'lead': 0, 'customer': 0, 'lost': 0}
- when empty_state_text() is called
-   giving 'No contacts yet.'
- then that gave 'No contacts yet.'

### A refused submission does not use up an id

- given a CRM
- when after_creating(name='', email='ann@example.com') is called
-   giving 'status 400'
- then that gave 'status 400'
- when after_creating(name='Ann Lee', email='ann@example.com') is called
-   giving 'redirect to /contacts/1'
- then that gave 'redirect to /contacts/1'
